subject: Common phrases and features for statements
notes: LANDED 2026-08-18 (PB66). A nonzero result nearer to zero than the resultant permits is the size error condition — the case only a floating-point numeric-edited (or floating-point usage) resultant can present: COMPUTE E3 = 1.0E-12 into 9.99E+9 under ON SIZE ERROR leaves E3 unchanged and runs the phrase (TryFormatFloat's Underflow outcome); a fixed-point resultant has no 'nearer to zero than permitted' (its low-order digits truncate, §14.6.8.2). Without the phrase / checking the MOVE disposition (zero) stands.
